BiblicalUsage: A fish is ordinary food in the Gospels, and Jesus makes it the sign of his provision. In Matthew 14:17 the disciples bring five loaves and two fishes, in Matthew 14:19 he blesses them and feeds five thousand, in Luke 5:6 the nets break with the catch at his word, and in John 21:11 Peter drags in a net full of great fishes after the resurrection.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fish in these stories is never just dinner: it is Jesus providing out of nothing. He calls fishermen, and he feeds a crowd with a boy's lunch.
